## ctxloom remote remove

Remove a remote source

### Synopsis

Remove a remote source from the registry.

Bare invocation reports what would be removed and removes nothing (exit 0).
Pass --yes to apply it. This only unregisters the remote — it never touches
content already pulled from it.

```
ctxloom remote remove <name> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -y, --yes   Apply the removal this invocation would report (default: report only)
```
